selection_policy.if_in_progress_exists: Continue the in_progress item unless the user redirects.
selection_policy.if_no_in_progress: Do not self-start the highest-priority not_started item. Start only from an explicit user request, maintainer-selected PR scope, or a clear issue/task mapping.
selection_policy.if_mapping_unclear: Ask for task selection or record the ambiguity before editing.

features.title: Add automatic historical backfill
features.user_visible_behavior: A new account can eventually mirror older messages beyond WINDOW_DAYS without manual intervention while fresh mail stays current.
features.evidence: PR-8 implemented three-lane history wiring on the working PR branch. Verified with pnpm --filter @supamail/api typecheck, targeted schema/repository/sync-engine/target-scheduler tests, Scenario L/M integration coverage, pnpm --filter @supamail/api spec-conformance (118 passed), and INSTALL_CMD=true RUN_LIVE_DB=1 ./init.sh.
features.notes: Historical backfill is resumable, bounded by the shared account lock budget, controlled by account settings, and observable through progress rollups. Reliability hardening PRs 1-8 are complete on the working PR branch.

features.title: Build IMAP compatibility matrix and protocol validation
features.user_visible_behavior: Docs and tests make generic IMAP support explicit, provider-by-provider, with known quirks isolated in provider profiles.
verification: pnpm smoke:greenmail when protocol behavior changes
features.evidence: Issue #3 provider compatibility slice added docs/imap-compatibility.md, ADR 0013, provider-profile quirk metadata, deterministic provider compatibility integration fixtures, UID search edge tests, and GreenMail smoke verification. Verified with pnpm --filter @supamail/api typecheck, targeted provider-profile/imap-client tests, pnpm --filter @supamail/api test:db:live, pnpm --filter @supamail/api smoke:greenmail against throwaway Postgres, and INSTALL_CMD=true RUN_LIVE_DB=1 ./init.sh.
features.notes: Generic IMAP support is framed as a minimum contract validated by provider shape. Live provider accounts remain manual smoke until safe provider-specific CI accounts exist.

features.title: Add MCP server for AI email tools
features.user_visible_behavior: A local stdio MCP server can safely expose read-oriented mailbox tools against an existing SupaMail database.
features.notes: Start local stdio first. Remote transport must be absent or explicitly bearer-token protected.
